name: Single-arm cable row with rotation
instructions: Sit or half-kneel facing the machine and hold one handle.
Let your shoulder reach forward, arm long.
Pull the handle to your ribs and turn your torso toward that arm.
Return with control, letting the shoulder reach forward.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
cue: Pull to the ribs, turn with the elbow
mistakes: Twisting from the lower back only.
Shrugging the shoulder up as you pull.
